description: Get full property detail by id or address — returns owner, estimated value, last sale, characteristics (beds/baths/sqft/year/lot), and mortgage. Example: realestateapi_property_detail({ address: "123 Main St, Austin, TX 78701", _apiKey: "your-key" })

address.description: Full property address (use if you have no id)

id.description: RealEstateAPI property id (from a search result)

name: realestateapi_property_detail
